jobs.title: Experienced Full Stack Software Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Ort, an dem die positive Einstellung und der unglaubliche Teamgeist die Schlüsselwerte deines Umfelds sind? Wir validieren und implementieren neue Technologien und schaffen maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Wir engagieren uns für eine Kultur der Innovation und der Einbeziehung neuer Technologien. Wir sind mutig, wenn es darum geht, für die beste Lösung einzutreten und ehrlich zu unseren Kunden oder Kollegen. Wir legen Wert auf Teamarbeit und glauben, dass gemeinsame Anstrengungen unerlässlich sind, um unsere Ziele und die unserer Kunden zu erreichen. Komm in unser Team und lass uns gemeinsam die Zukunft gestalten!  

Deine Aufgaben

Du konzipierst und entwickelst leistungsfähige, cloudfähige Softwarelösungen mit modernen Technologien wie Java, Go, TypeScript oder C#.
Mit Frameworks und Plattformen wie Angular, React, Spring oder .NET schaffst du eine zukunftsfähige und effiziente Entwicklungsumgebung.
Du gestaltest innovative Anwendungen von Grund auf oder unterstützt Unternehmen bei der digitalen Transformation bestehender Systeme.
In anspruchsvollen Projekten trägst du aktiv zur Entwicklung smarter Geschäftsanwendungen bei und setzt moderne Softwarearchitekturen um.
Du berätst Kunden zu technologischen Best Practices, bringst neue Impulse ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Umsetzung innovativer Lösungen.  

Dein Profil

Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Fullstack-Softwareentwicklung und kennst dich bestens mit Java, Go, TypeScript oder C# aus.
Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit modernen Frameworks wie Spring, React oder Angular und setzt diese effizient für performante Anwendungen ein.
Praktische Erfahrung in der Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) sowie mit Cloud-Technologien (AWS, Azure oder Google Cloud) ist für dich selbstverständlich.
Du entwickelst Software nach agilen Prinzipien (Scrum, Kanban) und bist mit CI/CD-Prozessen vertraut.
Clean Code, Design Patterns und skalierbare Architekturen sind für dich keine Buzzwords, sondern gelebte Praxis.  
Du bist ein proaktiver Problemlöser mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit.  
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1) für die Arbeit in internationalen Teams und für die Kommunikation mit deutschsprachigen Kunden.

Warum PRODYNA

Fürs Techie-♥: Abwechslungsreiche Technologie Stacks, Projekte und TechTalks  
Newcomer Days: Kennenlernen und Netzwerken mit anschließendem Mentoring-Programm   
Hardware:  Freie Wahl von Laptop und Smartphone   
Teamwork: Flache Hierarchie & regelmäßige Teambuilding-Events  
Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle & mobiles Arbeiten 
PRODYNA Akademie: Zahlreiche Fortbildungen plus 400 Euro pro Jahr für Online-Kurse deiner Wahl  
Job-Ticket oder Job-Bike: Du hast die Wahl 
Sportbegeisterte: Unternehmensintere Sport-Challenge, Gesundheitsmanagement und kostenlose Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM Wellpass   
Umfassende Betreuung: Umzugs- und Kindergartenzuschuss, betriebliche Altersvorsorge  
Hungrig? Wir bezuschussen dein Mittagessen, Snacks oder deinen Einkauf mit einem Essenszuschuss

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

Netwrix is on a mission to help customers protect and secure their identity and data landscape through market-leading on-prem and SaaS products and integrated solutions. Netwrix Identity products provide leading identity security solutions to thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Software Engineer

who will develop new features and capabilities for Netwrix

PingCastle

, leveraging and extending Netwrix’s enterprise cybersecurity platform. The Staff Software Engineer will ensure scalable, secure, high-quality experiences for enterprise customers in both on-prem and SaaS environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical leader to shape the future of cybersecurity threat prevention, detection, response, and recovery. You will contribute to the advancement of our products, solutions, and key technologies, with opportunities to integrate AI capabilities into our products and AI-first development process. Working closely with senior engineers and product leaders, you’ll influence architectural direction, mentor engineers, and help deliver solutions that protect organizations worldwide against advanced identity-based threats.

Key Responsibilities

Write high-quality code and design scalable backend services for on-prem and SaaS environments, setting examples of technical excellence for the team and supporting key decisions on architecture, scalability, and integration approaches
Integrate data and capabilities with Netwrix’s cybersecurity product platform and other Netwrix Identity and Data protection products.
Leverage Active Directory and Entra ID to identify, monitor, analyze, and report on identity security threats across hybrid environments
Promote and optimize the use of AI tools and capabilities to accelerate Netwrix product development
Utilize AI within Netwrix products to enable smarter threat detection, anomaly identification, and predictive analytics while ensuring interpretability and accuracy
Partner with customers and customer-facing teams to triage and address customer issues, understand customer needs, and obtain feedback on product features and functionality.
Collaborate across functions with product management, platform and product teams, and engineering leadership to ensure technical direction aligns with business needs
Mentor and support the growth of engineers while fostering a culture of innovation, security-first thinking, and technical excellence

Qualifications

Required Experience

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
8+ years of software development experience with a focus on enterprise software
Experience designing and delivering on-prem and SaaS software at scale
Familiarity with cloud platforms and SaaS security best practices
Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/observability

Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of distributed systems, modular architectures, and event-driven design
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), containerization (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, ARM)
Proficiency in designing RESTful APIs and asynchronous communication patterns
Strong proficiency in modern object-oriented programming languages and frameworks used in both on-prem and SaaS product development
Experience with modern databases and frameworks in high-performance scenarios, such as PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and Entity Framework Core
Understanding of Active Directory, Entra ID, or similar identity systems

Leadership & Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
Proven ability to balance technical quality with business priorities and timelines
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex, ambiguous challenges
Experience mentoring or guiding engineers in technical growth

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET)
Familiarity with threat detection methodologies, SIEM concepts, and security frameworks
Experience with Entra ID and hybrid cloud identity solutions
Familiarity with machine learning applications in threat detection
Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities
Experience developing products that support both on-prem and SaaS environments
Understanding of the ITDR market and solutions

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

Competitive Health Benefits
Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Please let us know if you require any accommodation.

jobs.title: Operations Engineer (f/m)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Netcompany was founded in 2000 with the headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Today, we are an international company with more than 9000+ employees working from over 10 locations. We serve a wide array of customers in their digital transformation journeys in public and private sectors across Europe.

We are excited by the challenge of doing things differently. At Netcompany we rely on one another and we develop quickly. We are team players. We change societies by creating life-changing IT solutions for variety of customers – from small private companies to large projects in the public sector. Our culture builds on low bureaucracy with a strong focus on high agility and flexibility.

Our culture emphasizes agility and flexibility, with minimal bureaucracy. Take a look at some of our impactful projects here: https://netcompany.com/cases/

As we prepare for new ventures, we are seeking ambitious individuals to join us on this journey.

Continue your development with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and assist you in achieving your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague ensures your well-being and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies, and management to communication. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, which ensures that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise, allowing you to be well-prepared to handle various tasks and continually improve throughout your career with us.

Job Description

Your everyday tasks will be:

Maintaining Microsoft-based environments (Azure Cloud and On-prem) for various projects based on SharePoint, Microsoft SQL servers, CRM, .NET custom applications and other
Participating in project work, as a part of development cycle, providing high level of availability of applications and systems based on SLA requirements
Reporting internally on tasks, activities and SLA goals.
Responding to customer requests, change management cycle, incidents etc. based on ITIL practices.
Working as part of an international IT Operations team

Qualifications

Your profile

Have a bachelor's, master's, or engineering degree in ICT/IT, computer science, software/computer engineering, infrastructure, or other relevant vocational education experience
Have 1–3 years of professional experience after graduation
Basic knowledge of Microsoft infrastructure and servers
Understanding TCP/IP from a server technical perspective
Security awareness
Experience/knowledge scripting (e.g. in PowerShell) would be an advantage
Proficiency in the English language is required

Additional Information

Our perks and benefits:

Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Multisport Card
Scandinavian work environment
Drinks, snacks, sweets & fruit available in our kitchens
Free English and Danish lessons at the office
Career development program for each employee and regular feedback
Internal and external training and certifications
International cooperation with colleagues from Denmark, Norway, the UK and Vietnam
Attractive office with a view and great location in Warsaw (Metro Wilanowska)

Send us your application

Please upload your CV to our recruitment system via the link. If you haven't received answers to all your questions, feel free to reach out to pl.hr@netcompany.com

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email HR at pl.hr@netcompany.com for assistance.

All qualified candidates are invited to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disabilities, age, religion and beliefs, political beliefs, nationality, ethnic or social background .

jobs.title: Senior IT Developer
jobs.description:
The role:

You will play a key role in developing and maintaining critical Enterprise Services within the Enterprise Digital Document Management domain. Working closely with Product Owners, Architects, QA engineers, and fellow developers, you will contribute to the successful delivery of new features, system integrations, and operational improvements while maintaining high engineering standards.

Responsibilities:

A brief core responsibility description includes:

Backend implementation with Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, gRPC, Kafka, event-driven microservices, Azure DevOps, Argo CD, Redis, and Observability.
Familiarity with JavaScript frameworks is beneficial.
Previous domain knowledge of document processing is an advantage.
Play a key role in driving delivery of ongoing projects and maintenance sprints.
Follow established SDKs, coding standards, development practices, and architectural guidelines, while challenging and changing them when needed.
Participate in code reviews and support continuous improvement of software quality.
Maintain a strong focus on SOLID principles, test coverage, and clean coding practices.
Support production releases and deployment activities as part of the development team.
Coordinate effectively with the testing/QA team during test cycles and releases.
Engage in continuous collaboration with digital core communities and DevSecOps and infrastructure teams for frameworks, processes, SDKs, and best practices.

Key Requirements:

Experience with Java as a Backend language.
Knowledge of Spring Boot as the Backend framework.
Proficiency in PostgreSQL as a relational database.
Familiarity with MongoDB as a NoSQL database.
Experience in Confluent Kafka and K streams for event streaming.
Containerization experience using Docker.
Knowledge of Kubernetes and Argo CD for container orchestration.
Experience with Azure and AWS cloud platforms.
Proficiency in Azure DevOps for CI/CD.
Familiarity with Keycloak OIDC for identity brokerage.

Additional technologies expected to be engaged with:

TypeScript / JavaScript as frontend languages.
React as a frontend library.
Material-UI as a frontend framework.
Redux for frontend state management.
NGINX for load balancing.

This senior role emphasizes collaboration, teamwork, and strategic development with a focus on avoiding siloed working. Necessary competences include:

Business fluency in both written and spoken English.
University degree in computer science or equivalent education.
4-6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
Effective cross-cultural communication with an international team.
Result-oriented and collaborative working mindset.
Familiarity with agile software delivery methodologies, e.g., SCRUM, Kanban.
Experience in JIRA and Confluence.

jobs.title: .NET Backend Developer - Automotive & Cloud
jobs.description:
NET Backend Developer - Automotive & Cloud

Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens uppkopplade fordon och digitala mobilitetstjänster?

CGI i Göteborg söker erfarna .NET Backend Developers som vill arbeta med modern backendutveckling hos några av Sveriges ledande företag inom fordonsindustrin.

Hos oss får du arbeta i teknikintensiva uppdrag där du utvecklar affärskritiska system, molnbaserade plattformar, API:er och backendtjänster för nästa generations fordon och digitala ekosystem.

Du blir en del av agila och tvärfunktionella team där samarbete, innovation och hög teknisk kvalitet står i centrum.

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter

Som .NET Backend Developer kommer du bland annat att:

Utveckla moderna backendlösningar och mikrotjänster i C#/.NET.
Designa och implementera REST API:er och integrationslösningar.
Utveckla skalbara och säkra molnbaserade applikationer.
Arbeta med databaser, event-driven arkitektur och integrationsplattformar.
Delta i teknisk design och arkitekturdiskussioner.
Säkerställa kvalitet genom automatiserade tester och CI/CD.
Arbeta tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och andra specialister i agila team.
Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av teknik, arbetssätt och utvecklingsprocesser.

Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll

Vi söker dig som har:

Minst 3 års erfarenhet av backendutveckling.
Goda kunskaper i C# och .NET/.NET Core.
Erfarenhet av REST API och integrationsutveckling.
Erfarenhet av SQL och databaser såsom SQL Server eller PostgreSQL.
Erfarenhet av Git, automatiserade tester och moderna utvecklingsverktyg.
Erfarenhet av agila utvecklingsmetoder.
God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

Microsoft Azure eller andra molnplattformar.
Docker och Kubernetes.
Azure Service Bus, Kafka eller andra messagingplattformar.
Microservices och event-driven architecture.
Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions eller andra CI/CD-lösningar.
Entity Framework.
Redis, MongoDB eller andra NoSQL-databaser.
OAuth2, OpenID Connect och Microsoft Entra ID.
Automotive, connected vehicles, telematik eller andra verksamhetskritiska system.

Vi tror att du är lösningsorienterad och nyfiken på modern teknik. Du uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och tar ansvar för kvaliteten i det du utvecklar.

Därför ska du välja CGI

På CGI i Göteborg får du arbeta i några av Sveriges mest spännande utvecklingsprojekt inom automotive och digitalisering. Vi kombinerar den globala organisationens möjligheter med det lokala teamets närhet och gemenskap.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med modern backendutveckling, Azure och komplexa digitala lösningar samtidigt som du utvecklas genom nya uppdrag, kompetensutveckling och certifieringar.

Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetsformer och en kultur där samarbete, innovation och kunskapsdelning står i centrum.

Godkänd bakgrundskontroll kommer att krävas för denna tjänst.

Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens digitala mobilitet tillsammans med oss? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan! Om du har några frågor kring tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta anders.haggdahl@cgi.com. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.

Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.

Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.

Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.
